mapper.select: WITH user_base AS ( SELECT id, name, email, created_at FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} ), profile_info AS ( SELECT user_id, phone_number, birth_date, address_line1, marketing_opt_in FROM user_profiles ), order_stats AS ( SELECT o.user_id, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent, MAX(o.created_at) AS last_order_at, MIN(o.created_at) AS first_order_at FROM orders o GROUP BY o.user_id ), recent_orders AS ( SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.user_id, o.customer_name, o.customer_email, o.customer_phone, o.shipping_address, o.status FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' ), recent_order_items AS ( SELECT ro.user_id, COUNT(oi.id) AS recent_item_count, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS recent_item_total FROM recent_orders ro JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = ro.order_id GROUP BY ro.user_id ), latest_order_snapshot AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (ro.user_id) ro.user_id, ro.customer_name AS latest_customer_name, ro.customer_email AS latest_customer_email, ro.customer_phone AS latest_customer_phone, ro.shipping_address AS latest_shipping_address FROM recent_orders ro ORDER BY ro.user_id, ro.order_id DESC ), primary_contact AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (ec.user_id) ec.user_id, ec.contact_name, ec.contact_phone, ec.relation FROM emergency_contacts ec WHERE ec.is_primary = true ORDER BY ec.user_id, ec.id ), default_payment AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (pm.user_id) pm.user_id, pm.card_holder_name, pm.card_number_masked, pm.expiry_month, pm.expiry_year FROM payment_methods pm WHERE pm.default_method = true ORDER BY pm.user_id, pm.id ) SELECT ub.id, ub.name, ub.email, ub.created_at, pi.phone_number, pi.birth_date, pi.address_line1, CASE WHEN pi.marketing_opt_in THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS marketing_opt_in_label, COALESCE(os.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(os.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent, os.first_order_at, os.last_order_at, COALESCE(oi.recent_item_count, 0) AS recent_item_count, COALESCE(oi.recent_item_total, 0) AS recent_item_total, los.latest_customer_name, los.latest_customer_email, los.latest_customer_phone, los.latest_shipping_address, pc.contact_name AS primary_contact_name, pc.contact_phone AS primary_contact_phone, pc.relation AS primary_contact_relation, dp.card_holder_name AS default_card_holder_name, dp.card_number_masked AS default_card_number_masked, dp.expiry_month AS default_card_expiry_month, dp.expiry_year AS default_card_expiry_year, ub.name || ' <' || ub.email || '>' AS display_label, CASE WHEN pc.contact_name IS NOT NULL THEN ub.name || ' / 비상연락처: ' || pc.contact_name ELSE ub.name END AS name_with_emergency_contact FROM user_base ub LEFT JOIN profile_info pi ON pi.user_id = ub.id LEFT JOIN order_stats os ON os.user_id = ub.id LEFT JOIN recent_order_items oi ON oi.user_id = ub.id LEFT JOIN latest_order_snapshot los ON los.user_id = ub.id LEFT JOIN primary_contact pc ON pc.user_id = ub.id LEFT JOIN default_payment dp ON dp.user_id = ub.id ORDER BY ub.id
